Wakanzwa zvakataurwa nemurume nemushandi wematikiti. Havana kutaura kuti nzvimbo ndeipi.

x-e-e2-05.s.s1.prompt: Unogona kusarudza nzvimbo imwe kubva pamitsetse miviri iyi bedzi here?

x-e-e2-05.s.s1.explain: Ticket ne show i mashoko anoshandiswa munzvimbo dzakawanda, sa cinema kana concert hall. Zvakaoma kusarudza imwe kubva pamitsetse miviri bedzi.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mitsetse yese yekuwedzera inopatsanura kuti nzvimbo i 'cinema' kana 'concert hall'.

x-e-e2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana mitsetse inosara ichienderana nerimwe chete zvakanyanya.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.a: Popcorn i chikafu chinowanzotengwa mu cinema. Inogona kuva chiratidzo chinopatsanura kubva ku concert hall.

x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.c: Screen (chiratidziro) i izwi rinokosha zvakanyanya mu cinema kupfuura mu concert hall. Rinogona kuva chiratidzo chinopatsanura zviviri.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.d: Kuudzwa kunyarara kunonzwikwa munzvimbo dzose mbiri.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.explain: Mashoko anoenderana nevasarudzwa vose (mitsara yezvigaro, kunyarara) haapatsanuri nzvimbo. Popcorn ne screen i zviratidzo zvakaswedera ku cinema. Asi zvingaoma kusarudza zvizere nemutsetse mumwe chete.

x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sarudza fungidziro imwe ine musoro zvakanaka zvichibva pazviratidzo kusvika zvino. (Pangave nemhinduro mbiri dzine musoro.)
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kubva pamutsetse mumwe, imbwa kana mwana zvose zvinogoneka. Hapana chiratidzo chakakwana kusarudza imwe.

x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Mashoko aya anoshandiswawo kuvana. Mutsetse mumwe haukusiyanise nembwa.

x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Sit!' nekukanda bhora i mitambo inowanzotambwa nevanhu nembwa.

x-e-e2-03.s.s1.reflect: Kunyangwe wakatanga wafungidzira imbwa, zvine musoro kuchinja kufunga kwako zvichienderana nechiratidzo chitsva (Max anotaura). Fungidziro yakasarudzwa kubva pamutsetse mumwe chete inogona kuchinja pamberi pechiratidzo chitsva.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.prompt: Munhaurirano itsva, unoda kuti zvive pachena kuti Max i 'imbwa.' Nyora mutsetse mumwe weChirungu unosanganisira Max.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Funga zvinhu zvinoitwa nembwa kana ruzha runoitwa nembwa.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Isa zita Max nechiratidzo ichocho pamwe chete mumutsara mumwe.

x-e-e2-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shoko iri rinogona kushandiswawo kumwana here?

x-e-e2-04.goal: Kubva pachikwangwani chine nguva dzekuvhura nenguva yekuchenesa, tsvaga nguva dzakati wandei dzekutanga dzinoita kuti kushambira kwemaminitsi 30 kugoneke zvizere.

City Pool

x-e-e2-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Nyora awa se integer kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 5 uye maminitsi se integer kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 59.
x-e-e2-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Waizotanga pamberi pe 2:00, kana kupedzisira wakashambira kupfuura 5:00.
x-e-e2-04.s.s2.explain: Nguva dzinogoneka dzekutanga i 2:00-2:30 (kupera pa 3:00) ne 3:30-4:30 (kupera pa 5:00). Semuenzaniso, 2:00 ne 4:00 dzinoshanda, asi 3:00 inopindirana nekuchenesa uye 4:45 inopfuura 5:00, saka hadzishande.

x-e-e2-09.title: Gadzira mutsara usingakodzeri mumashoko ezvibereko uupe shamwari semuzungu
x-e-e2-09.goal: Nzwisisa kuti mutsara upi usingakodzeri unoenderana nechinyorwa, uye gadzira musoro mumwe nemutsara mumwe usingaenderani nawo.
x-e-e2-09.material:
Uchagadzira muzungu we 'odd one out' kupa shamwari. Chekutanga, ngatitarisei muenzaniso mumwe.

I like apples. I like bananas. Grapes are sweet. ?
x-e-e2-09.prereq.0: Mitsara yakareruka senge I like ~. ne ~ is/are ...
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Taura musoro wakafanana wemitsara mitatu yekutanga neshoko rimwe.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana pane mutsara usingaenderani nemusoro uyu.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.a: A peach is a fruit, saka inokodzera musoro.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.b: An orange inewo chibereko, saka inokodzera.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.c: A carrot haisi chibereko. Kana musoro uchionekwa se 'chibereko', haikodzeri.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.explain: Mitsara mitatu yekutanga yose iri pamusoro pezvibereko (maapuro, mabhanana, mazambiringa). Carrot muriwo, saka haikodzeri musoro. Kana ukawedzera musoro kuita 'chikafu', carrot inogona kukodzerawo. Kana inokodzera kana kwete zvinoenderana nezvaunosarudza kuva musoro.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira muzungu wekupa shamwari. (1) Mitsara mitatu yeChirungu inoenderana nemusoro mumwe, (2) mutsara mumwe usingakodzeri (wechina), (3) nyora mhinduro pakupedzisira, senge "Odd one: 4."
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza musoro mumwe (mhuka, chikoro, chikafu, nezvimwe) uye tanga wanyora mitsara mitatu yemusoro iwoyo.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mutsara wemusoro mumwe semutsara wechina, uye uwedzere 'Odd one: 4.'
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Musoro wemitsara mitatu yekutanga wakajeka here kuti ndimwe chete?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mutsara wechina uri pamusoro wakasiyana asi une chimiro chakafanana here?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shamwari yako kana ichigadzirisa, ichashandisa chiratidzo chipi kuwana mhinduro?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.0: Kutaura nezve chikafu kwakapindirana mubhuku renyaya yekatsi.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Mutsara wetiger wakapindirana mubhuku renyaya yechikoro.

x-e-e2-10.title: Gadzira mubvunzo mumwe unotsvaga ruzivo runoshaikwa mu text message
x-e-e2-10.goal: Tsvaga ruzivo rusiri mumeseji, sarudza mubvunzo mumwe unobatsira zvikuru, uye gadzira mubvunzo wako muchiitiko chitsva.
x-e-e2-10.material:
Shamwari yako Sora yakatumira text.

"Let's play tomorrow! Bring a ball."

Unoda kuenda, asi hauzive zvinhu zvishoma.
x-e-e2-10.prereq.0: Mashoko emibvunzo senge When, Where, What time
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mubvunzo mumwe unobatsira zvikuru wekubvunza Sora.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kamura meseji kuita makoramu maviri: zvainokuudza kare nezvausingazivi.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Funga zvauri kufanira kuziva kuti musangane.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.a: Mubvunzo uyu unobvunza ruzivo rwuviri panguva imwe: nzvimbo nenguva, zvose zvakakosha pakusangana.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.b: Meseji yatoti uuye nebhora. Rudzi rwebhora rwaizonaka kuziva, asi harupi ruzivo rumwe rwunodiwa.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.c: Unogona kuziva nzvimbo, asi uchiri kusaziva nguva. Chinhu chimwe chete chagadziriswa.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.d: Kuti Sora anoda mabhora here hakusi ruzivo rwunodiwa kuti musangane.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.explain: Meseji ine "tomorrow" ne "bring a ball" chete, uye inoshaya nzvimbo nenguva. Mubvunzo unobvunza ruzivo rwuviri panguva imwe ndiwo unobatsira zvikuru. Mubvunzo unobvunza nzvimbo chete unosiya nguva isingazikanwi, uye mibvunzo yerudzi rwebhora kana zvinoda Sora hazvisi ruzivo rwakakosha pakusangana.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.prompt: Ichiitiko chitsva. Baba vakati: "We'll go on a trip on Saturday." Nyora mubvunzo mumwe wechiRungu unotsvaga ruzivo rwakakosha zvikuru runoshaikwa. (Shandisa chiratidzo chimwe chete che question mark)
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Paradzanisa zvauri kuziva kubva mumashoko aBaba (Saturday, trip) nezvausingazivi.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza chimwe chezvausingazivi uye ugadzire mubvunzo unotanga ne Where kana What time.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mubvunzo wangu unobvunza ruzivo rusiri mumashoko aBaba here?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mhinduro yemubvunzo iwoyo yaibatsira pakugadzirira rwendo here?
